parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25965~~).

parameters.name: LifecycleActionResult
parameters.description:
The next action to take after the lifecycle hook wait state ends. Valid values:

- CONTINUE: continues responding to a scale-out activity and adds ECS instances to the scaling group. Continues responding to a scale-down activity and removes ECS instances from the scaling group.
- ABANDON: terminates the scale-out activity and releases the created ECS instances. Continues responding to the scale-down activity and removes ECS instances from the scaling group.
- ROLLBACK: rejects the release of ECS instances during a scale-down activity and performs a rollback. For a scale-out activity, the effect is the same as ABANDON.

If you do not specify this parameter, the next action after the lifecycle hook wait state ends remains the `DefaultResult` value configured for the lifecycle hook.

When multiple lifecycle hooks in a scaling group are triggered simultaneously, the final next action is determined as follows:

- For a scale-down activity, when the wait state triggered by a lifecycle hook of the `ABANDON` or `ROLLBACK` type ends, the wait states of subsequent lifecycle hooks are completed ahead of schedule.
- For a `CONTINUE` type lifecycle hook that suspends a scale-down activity, or for a scale-out activity, subsequent lifecycle hooks continue to suspend the scaling activity until the wait state triggered by the last lifecycle hook ends. The final next action is determined by the type of the last lifecycle hook whose wait state ends.

parameters.name: LifecycleActionToken
parameters.description: The token that indicates the wait state of the scaling activity. You can obtain this value from the MNS queue or MNS topic specified by the lifecycle hook.

parameters.name: LifecycleHookId
parameters.description: The ID of the lifecycle hook.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the scaling group.
